title: Saturday Morning
subtitle: No alarm, no shop, no bus. Emma's one slow morning of the week.
description: An A1 reading and listening text about a free morning, bringing together the people, places and vocabulary of the other A1 readings.
source: authored for this site; no source document
passage: On Saturday I don't work, so I don't put the alarm on. I sleep in until nine. It is the best morning of the week.
Jack gets up first. When I come into the kitchen there is coffee, and the window is open.
We have a slow breakfast — eggs, bread, fruit. We don't talk much. We don't have to.
Then we clean the apartment. I wash the plates and Jack does the laundry. It takes an hour.
After that we go out. If it is warm we take a walk in the park near our building. If it rains we stay home and read.
At one o'clock Sam comes down from upstairs with his dog. We talk in front of the building for ten minutes.
In the afternoon we do nothing, and that is the point. On Monday I get up at five again.

vocabulary.definition: the clock that makes a noise to wake you up
to stay in bed later than usual
the reason why something is good or important

exercises.title: Understanding the Text
exercises.instructions: Read again and choose the best answer.

items.prompt: Why doesn't Emma use the alarm on Saturday?
options: Because she doesn't work that day
items.explanation: “On Saturday I don't work, so I don't put the alarm on.”
“Jack gets up first” — the coffee is ready when she comes in.

items.prompt: Why don't they talk much at breakfast?
items.explanation: “We don't talk much. We don't have to.”

items.prompt: What do they do after breakfast?
items.explanation: “Then we clean the apartment” — it takes an hour.

items.prompt: What do they do if the weather is bad?
items.explanation: “If it rains we stay home and read.”

options: Because they do nothing, and that is what they want
items.explanation: “we do nothing, and that is the point.”

exercises.title: Who Does What?
exercises.instructions: Match each person to what they do on Saturday.

pairs.right: sleeps until nine and washes the plates
gets up first, makes coffee, does the laundry
comes down from upstairs with his dog
take a walk in the park if it is warm

exercises.title: Words from the A1 Texts
exercises.instructions: Choose the word that matches the meaning.

items.prompt: To stay in bed later than usual is to ___.
items.explanation: To sleep in is to stay in bed later than usual.

items.prompt: The clothes you wash are the ___.
items.explanation: Laundry is the clothes you wash.

items.prompt: I don't want to go out. I want to ___ home.
items.explanation: To stay is to not leave a place.

items.prompt: There is ___ in the refrigerator. We have to go to the store.
To need to do something is to ___ do it.
items.explanation: To have to is to need to do something.

discussion: What do you do on Saturday morning?
Do you sleep in, or do you get up early?
Who cleans and washes in your home?
Is your weekend slow or busy?
